findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mesoamerican-astrology" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_mesoamerican_astrology_mayan_daily, get_mesoamerican_astrology_aztec_daily · Public sink: post_mesoamerican_astrology_mayan_tzolkin, post_mesoamerican_astrology_mayan_chart, post_mesoamerican_astrology_mayan_long_count_convert, post_mesoamerican_astrology_mayan_compatibility, post_mesoamerican_astrology_aztec_tonalpohualli.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_mesoamerican_astrology_mayan_daily, get_mesoamerican_astrology_aztec_daily · Public sink: post_mesoamerican_astrology_mayan_tzolkin, post_mesoamerican_astrology_mayan_chart, post_mesoamerican_astrology_mayan_long_count_convert, post_mesoamerican_astrology_mayan_compatibility, post_mesoamerican_astrology_aztec_tonalpohualli

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
